Temporal reasoning encompasses the understanding of time-related relationships, including time-time, time-event, and event-event correlations. This capability allows Large Language Models (LLMs) to process and interpret the evolving nature of information, which is essential in fields sensitive to temporal changes, such as finance, healthcare, and legal studies.
